svg.title: Three inventories for one AI system
svg.desc: Software SBOM covers train and serve packages via cyclonedx-py or Syft into Grype. ML-BOM covers the pack on disk with CycloneDX machine-learning-model hashes. AIBOM covers what the running system calls: local tags, Modelfiles, and cloud model IDs.

text.font-family: Comic Sans MS, Chalkboard SE, Segoe Print, cursive
Comic Sans MS, Chalkboard SE, Segoe Print, cursive

svg.text: pip freeze never sees the model tag. The pack BOM never sees the cloud endpoint.
